content: Core Stripe subscription lifecycle events an entitlement sync handler must cover: checkout.session.completed (initial subscription creation/activation after Checkout), customer.subscription.updated (plan changes, renewal, status transitions e.g. active/past_due/unpaid), customer.subscription.deleted (cancellation/expiration -- must revoke entitlement), invoice.payment_succeeded (renewal confirmation, reset failure counters), invoice.payment_failed (failed renewal -- start grace period / dunning, eventually revoke). Handlers should treat these as reconciliation triggers (refetch subscription/customer state from Stripe) rather than trusting embedded payload fields as final truth, since retries and out-of-order delivery are expected.
